business_problem: HDFC Bank has long been at the forefront of technology adoption, utilizing data-driven decision-making to maintain their competitive edge and provide superior customer service and experiences. However, due to customer growth and increased data management complexity, there were limitations in how they could continue to scale up some of their tech, especially their campaign operations.
solution_summary: Hdfc Bank built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Apache Spark. HDFC Bank has long been at the forefront of technology adoption, utilizing data-driven decision-making to maintain their competitive edge and provide superior customer service and experiences. However, due to customer growth and increased data management complexity, there were limitations in how they could continue to scale up some of their tech, especially their campaign operations. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Apache Spark processes large-scale transformations and analytics over unified datasets.

business_outcome: HDFC Bank’s CRAIN department’s migration to the Databricks Data + AI Platform has enhanced their data analytics capabilities for credit-related use cases. The platform has simplified the integration of various data sources, streamlined data processing and improved analytics capabilities — enabling the department to uncover new actionable insights.
